title: NLP-based Message Prioritisation for Opportunistic Routing: A Case Study of Nepal Earthquake Emergency Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.37933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This dissertation investigates whether Natural Language Processing (NLP) based semantic message prioritisation can improve the treatment of urgent disaster messages in opportunistic emergency communication, using the 2015 Nepal earthquake as a case study. TF IDF with Logistic Regression and BERT are used to classify social media messages into nine humanitarian categories, which are mapped to four routing priorities from P1 to P4. These priorities are integrated into the ONE simulator within a controlled Kathmandu earthquake scenario using a modified Binary Spray and Wait router. BERT achieves higher priority accuracy and P1 recall than Logistic Regression, while reducing under prioritisation and severe priority errors. However, improved NLP performance does not produce uniform network gains. P1 delivery probability remains high and similar across routing conditions, and no consistent latency reduction is observed. translated_title: 基于NLP的机会路由消息优先级排序：尼泊尔地震应急通信案例研究
translated_abstract: 本论文以2015年尼泊尔地震为案例研究，探讨基于自然语言处理（NLP）的语义消息优先级排序能否改善机会式应急通信中对紧急灾害消息的处理。研究使用TF-IDF结合逻辑回归以及BERT将社交媒体消息分类为九个人道主义类别，这些类别被映射到从P1到P4的四个路由优先级。这些优先级通过改进的Binary Spray and Wait路由器，被集成到ONE模拟器中的受控加德满都地震场景里。实验结果表明，BERT相比逻辑回归实现了更高的优先级分类准确率和P1召回率，同时减少了优先级低估和严重的优先级错误。然而，NLP性能的提升并未带来一致的网络收益。P1消息的投递概率在各种路由条件下均保持较高且相似的水平，也未观察到一致的延迟降低。最明显的差异（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究将BERT和逻辑回归用于灾害社交媒体消息的优先级分类并集成到机会路由中，发现尽管BERT的分类准确率更高，但NLP性能提升并未转化为一致的投递率或延迟等网络性能收益。
en_tdlr: Although BERT-based NLP message prioritisation outperforms Logistic Regression in classification accuracy, the improved NLP performance does not translate into consistent gains in delivery probability or latency reduction in opportunistic disaster communication routing.
